# Crypto in Brief

> Illustrated cryptocurrency explainers with interactive browser labs for readers with no assumed technical or financial background.

## Start here

- [Crypto in Brief](https://cryptoinbrief.xyz/): Reading paths plus an interactive payment walkthrough with real browser signature verification and a modeled network and ledger.
- [Bitcoin and crypto, illustrated](https://cryptoinbrief.xyz/crypto-summary.html): A visual overview of hashing, mining, signatures, transaction models, privacy, consensus, and execution.

## English essays

- [Bitcoin from zero](https://cryptoinbrief.xyz/bitcoin-from-zero.html): Hashing, blocks, Merkle trees, mining, nodes, signatures, forks, finality, and transaction ordering with browser labs.
- [The Bitcoin white paper, explained](https://cryptoinbrief.xyz/bitcoin-whitepaper.html): A section-by-section public explanation of the 2008 paper that distinguishes the original proposal from Bitcoin today. Published 20 September 2026.
- [Inside the Bitcoin Core codebase](https://cryptoinbrief.xyz/bitcoin-codebase.html): A developer guide to transaction parsing, validation, mempool admission, mining selection, block connection, and tests, with direct source references. Published 20 September 2026.
- [Bitcoin and Monero white papers compared](https://cryptoinbrief.xyz/bitcoin-vs-monero-whitepapers.html): Compares the 2008 Bitcoin paper with the 2013 CryptoNote paper and explains that current Monero is not identical to CryptoNote's original design. Published 20 September 2026.
- [Proof of stake from zero](https://cryptoinbrief.xyz/proof-of-stake.html): Validators, proposer selection, attestations, fork choice, slashing, and economic finality through Ethereum examples and simulations.
- [Solana from zero](https://cryptoinbrief.xyz/solana.html): Proof of history, slots, Tower BFT, validator voting, and parallel execution with three interactive labs.
- [Sui from zero](https://cryptoinbrief.xyz/sui.html): Sui's object model, owned and shared transactions, Mysticeti consensus, Move types, and zkLogin.
- [Monero under the hood](https://cryptoinbrief.xyz/monero-under-the-hood.html): Stealth addresses, ring signatures, key images, RingCT, network privacy, and the limits of toy cryptographic models.
- [How to get Monero](https://cryptoinbrief.xyz/getting-monero.html): Compares atomic swaps, Haveno P2P, instant swappers, and exchanges by custody, privacy, liquidity, fees, and trust, with preference and referral disclosures.
- [Crypto terms that actually show up in a wallet](https://cryptoinbrief.xyz/crypto-terms.html): Practical glossary of wallet, address, seed, gas, mempool, confirmation time, staking, restaking, finality, UTXO versus account, CEX versus DEX, and stablecoin, dated 20 September 2026.
- [How to start using crypto](https://cryptoinbrief.xyz/starting-with-crypto.html): Hot versus hardware wallets, Rabby versus MetaMask, Jupiter versus Phantom, Etherscan and Solana explorers, crypto cards (Ether.fi, Plasma One, Jupiter Card), and 24/7 stock tokens on Arcus, with referral disclosures.
- [Dollar yield in DeFi](https://cryptoinbrief.xyz/dollar-yield.html): How to read DefiLlama yields, how Ethena produces sUSDe rewards, and what looping on Kamino does, with dated numbers and an Ethena referral disclosure.
- [Zcash from zero](https://cryptoinbrief.xyz/zcash.html): Shielded notes, nullifiers, viewing keys, optional privacy, and the documented lineage from Israeli and American research to a coin launched by a US company.
- [Zero knowledge from zero](https://cryptoinbrief.xyz/zero-knowledge-from-zero.html): Interactive proofs, Fiat Shamir, SNARKs, STARKs, selective disclosure, and privacy preserving identity.

## Arabic essays

- [البيتكوين والكريبتو، ملخص مرسوم](https://cryptoinbrief.xyz/crypto-summary-ar.html): شرح مرسوم للهاش والتعدين والتوقيعات والخصوصية وآليات الإجماع من غير خلفية مسبقة.
- [البيتكوين من الصفر](https://cryptoinbrief.xyz/bitcoin-from-zero-ar.html): شرح الهاش والبلوكات وشجرة Merkle والتعدين والتحقق من خلال تجارب داخل المتصفح.
- [مونيرو من الصفر](https://cryptoinbrief.xyz/monero-from-zero-ar.html): شرح إخفاء المستلم والمرسل والمبلغ بالعناوين الخفية والتوقيعات الحلقية وRingCT.

## Project facts

- Author: [Moamen Basel](https://moamenbasel.com)
- Professional affiliation: [Grey Core Labs](https://greycorelabs.com)
- Languages: English and Arabic
- Format: Static HTML essays with SVG illustrations and browser JavaScript
- Labs: A documented mix of Web Crypto operations and teaching simulations
- Source: [GitHub](https://github.com/cryptoinbrief/cryptoinbrief.xyz)
- License: MIT
